How to read this. Walls, glazing, doors, joinery and amenities come from the calibrated Review 01 reconstruction. The entry lounge, courtyard, warehouse, storage studio, kitchen, front open area, design room and east open area are finished from site photos. The street frontage, sign tower, neighbouring warehouse, parking canopy and the AIIMS Jimny follow the street photo. Other desks, tables and plants are an illustrative fit-out. The roof, upper floor level and stair are estimates.
